stem: Find the maximum value of 3 cosθ + 4 sinθ.
The minimum value of the expression (9x² sin²x + 4)/(x sinx), x ∈ (0, π) is: (a) 16/3 (b) 6 (c) 12 (d) 8/3
If the equation cos⁴θ + sin⁴θ + λ = 0 has real solutions for θ, then λ lies in the interval: [Sep. 02, 2020 (III)] (a) (−5/4, −1) (b) [−1, −1/2] (c) (−1/2, −1/4] (d) [−3/2, −5/4]
